CheckTitle: Okta Admin Console policy enforces MFA
Description: The app sign-in policy mapped to the Okta Admin Console is evaluated so broad active rules require MFA or deny access.
Risk: Admin Console access with a single factor exposes the Okta control plane to credential theft, privilege escalation, policy tampering, and tenant takeover.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authentication Policies > App sign-in.
2. Open the Okta Admin Console policy.
3. Edit each active broad, default, or catch-all rule.
4. Set User must authenticate with to a two-factor option and prefer phishing-resistant possession constraints.
5. Repeat for the catch-all rule and save the policy.

Recommendation.Text: Require MFA for every active broad or catch-all Okta Admin Console app sign-in rule.

Notes: Requires okta.policies.read. The parser supports Classic and Identity Engine policy action variants.
